_description: Maps (country_code, admin_level) to output field. Country code is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (upper case). If a country has no entry or the admin_level is not listed, defaults.admin is consulted. Unlisted levels are ignored.

AU._note: Australia Post uses SUBURB not LGA as the postal locality. Admin hierarchy: 2=country, 4=state, 6=LGA (e.g. 'City of Sydney'), 7=district (mostly ACT), 9=suburb ('Sydney', 'Bondi'), 11=postcode. Level-9 has a max_area cap because OSM occasionally tags remote pastoral stations at this level with polygons >1000 km²; real urban suburbs are always well below 0.05 sq deg (~500 km²).

NZ._note: NZ Post uses City (TA) + suburb. Admin hierarchy: 2=country, 4=region, 6=TA ('Auckland', 'Wellington'), 10=suburb, 11=postcode.
